Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Vânzări cu amănuntul
Digital. Inspiring. Unique.
 Tchibo is one of the ten largest eCommerce companies in Germany. We could never have attained this standing without the courage to constantly rethink the old ways. In the digital world at Tchibo, we work with the latest technologies to develop sustainable and effective solutions. Do you want to help us do this? Enrich our team with your fresh ideas!
 Your tasks: You make the difference with us. 
 This position is located in Bucharest, Romania. 
 As a Full Stack Developer (m/f/d) in our Bucharest office, you’ll be a vital part of the Webshop Team , an innovative and agile group that supports the entire customer journey on the Tchibo eCommerce platform . At Tchibo, the customer is always at the center of our work, and we rely on your skills to create seamless and engaging digital experiences.
Are you passionate about developing and operating complex web applications using modern technologies? Are you excited to collaborate in an agile, fast-paced environment to solve complex challenges?
If yes, this is the opportunity for you! 
 In detail:
 End-to-End Development : Design, build, and maintain customer-centric microservices with a full technology stack (frontend, backend, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines). 
 Code Excellence : Write clean, high-quality code and ensure performance and security through pair programming, code reviews, and TDD. 
 Collaboration : Work closely with designers, developers, architects, testers, and project managers on cutting-edge projects. 
 Continuous Improvement : Stay updated on the latest technologies and contribute to personal development through conferences, Tchibo conventions, and online learning. 
 Innovation Time : Dedicate creative time during each iteration to work on projects that excite you. 
 Your profile: You keep reinventing us. 
 Required Qualifications: 
 A degree in computer science, business informatics, or equivalent. 
 7+ years of experience in software development/architecture with a passion for new technologies. 
 Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages, such as Kotlin, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 Familiarity with Git, CI/CD automation, object-relational databases, and SQL scripting. 
 Strong knowledge of web development and ownership of microservices. 
 Fluency in English (written and spoken). 
 A collaborative team player who thrives in agile environments (SCRUM/KANBAN). 
 Nice to have: 
 Experience with Vue.js 3, Nuxt 3 , or Vite for web application development. 
 Familiarity with software architecture and self-contained microservices. 
 Knowledge of cloud development, preferably on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with tools like CloudSQL, Pub/Sub, GKE, Terraform, and Kubernetes. 
 Your benefits: Together we stay different. 
 Work-Life Balance: Flexible, hybrid working policy with 26 vacation days + your birthday off. 
 Benefits: Monthly transport allowance (80 RON/month), meal tickets, and health/life insurance. 
 Personal Perks: Free Tchibo coffee for home, and the chance to work on cutting-edge technology in a dynamic environment. 
 Innovative Work Environment: We are a forward-thinking team where creativity and innovation are encouraged. You will collaborate with talented professionals and contribute to building Tchibo Tech, shaping the future of our technology landscape. 
 Inclusive Culture: A diverse and inclusive workplace where your unique perspectives and ideas are valued, fostering a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 
 Impactful Work: Our meaningful projects make a real difference, driving positive change and contributing to the success of Tchibo. 
 Our job suits you? Then we are looking forward to your application! It's super fast: upload attachments, our motivation questions answer - done. Without a cover letter !
 Your contact person is Crina Zamfir.
